summary: Backend-only retest of the 💼 Reseller in-bot form (RESELLER_APPLY_FORM=true), driving the real bot on :5000 with mock Telegram on :5099. Smoke 30/30, deep 103/103, escape 14/14. New extended suite 45/45. It covers: escaping from the note step (🏠 Main Menu / 👛 Wallet); fr/zh/hi wallet and main-menu labels on the brand step (draft cancelled with cancelReason left_form, label not saved, action≠rsApply, the target menu is shown); /cancel and localized ❌ Cancel on the services step (Application cancelled, status cancelled not left_form, panelMsgId buttons removed); /start on the services step (panel cleared, stale rsa:c answers 'This step is closed.' and its buttons are removed); Skip and Back are still not treated as escapes. BlockBee: 200 USDT (≈$199.8) and 185 USDT count as paid with no wallet credit and a PRIORITY admin card; 150 USDT → pending_payment, $149.84 to the wallet and an admin UNDERPAYMENT alert; 260 USDT → paid with $59.7 excess to the wallet; an unpriceable coin → falls back to the invoice (no '$null') and sends the admin '⚠️ [CryptoCredit] … could not price' note. Upgrade from Standard: the old adminMsg buttons are removed before the new 'Upgraded from Standard' card is sent, and adminMsg is repointed. alertResellerApplication: with 2 injected 500s the card is delivered on attempt 3 (backoff ≈2s/4s); with 3 injected 500s the '🚨 [Reseller] Could not deliver the application card … PAID' fallback is sent and the app stays paid. All 4 minor items from iteration_110 are verified fixed.

minor.endpoint: rsApply services step: ⬅️ Back (reseller-apply.js handleInput back branch / _index.js rsApply branch)
minor.issue: Back from the services step does not clear the services inline panel. When the user comes back to services, a new panel is sent (panelMsgId is overwritten) and the OLD panel stays live: tapping a toggle on it still edits the draft and redraws the old message. Data stays consistent (same draft), but there are two live panels, and abandon/cancel later only clears the newest one. Repro: probe_reseller_panel_edge_2026-10.js (a). Fix: clear the panel when leaving the services step via Back (handleInput could return panelMsgId like cancel does), and/or check query.message.message_id === app.panelMsgId in toggleService/continueServices.

Only labels in the user's own language count as escapes (trans('user') + isMainMenuPress). A fr user who sends the English '👛 Wallet' (for example from an old cached keyboard) gets it saved as the brand. This is an edge case; it could also check the user.* labels of all languages.

action_items: (Minor) Clear the services panel on ⬅️ Back from services, or make toggles/continue only act on the current panelMsgId
(Optional) Match main-menu labels in all languages for the rsApply escape
critical_code_review_comments: resolveCryptoCreditUsd with feePayer 'company' credits the full invoice when conversion fails (src=none). A payment in an unpriceable or garbage coin therefore marks the Priority app as paid, whatever the amount; the only safeguard is the admin 'could not price' note. This matches the DynoPay policy and needs a valid ref (forging the callback is already a full bypass anyway), so it is low risk, but the admin should verify these.
Small overpays (for example 201 USDT → $0.79) send sentMoreMoney and a wallet credit for cents. This is cosmetic.
isFormLabel includes btn.menu ('🏠 Main Menu'), but isMainMenuPress is checked first, so Main Menu still escapes correctly (verified in all 4 languages).
The deep suite's BlockBee 'underpay' case uses 50 USDT (<90%), so it still passes with the 10% tolerance. No expectation change was needed.
